alt: Baby blue Ferrari Luce EV photographed in three-quarter front view, showing the car's unusually low cowl and windshield wiper blades positioned vertically along the A-pillars rather than resting flat along the bottom of the windshield
story: Ferrari's Jony Ive-designed Luce EV has a cowl so aerodynamically low there is no gutter for wiper blades, forcing Ferrari to file a patent for a new electromagnetic sliding wiper system — because they optimised the car's lines until rain became an engineering emergency.
why_funny: Ferrari spent years perfecting every curve of the Luce, then had to reinvent one of the oldest automotive components because nowhere on their beautiful car could traditional windshield wipers actually go.
